    How to buy a Swiggy Money Voucher?

    Buying a Swiggy Money Voucher is simple: 

    • Visit www.gyftr.com.
    • Log in using your account credentials.
    • Search ‘Swiggy Money’ in the search bar.
    • Choose the desired denomination. 
    • Click on the BUY NOW button and complete the transaction using the available payment modes.
    • You will receive the Swiggy Money Voucher via SMS/Email/WhatsApp.

    How to redeem Swiggy Money Vouchers?

    • Download/update the latest Swiggy app. Log in to the Swiggy app and go to your profile
    • Scroll down and tap on "claim gift card" under the 'Credits and gift cards' section.
    • Enter the 16-digit gift card code and PIN to claim your gift card. 
    • The claimed gift card amount will be added to your Swiggy credits balance. 
    • The balance can then be used to place an order on the Swiggy app.
